scenarios.description: Baseline free-flowing to moderate mixed traffic with realistic signal delays.
scenarios.calibration_notes: Produces ~160 vehicles, 4.6 km/h avg, max Q 150m. Visually identifiable as normal operating regime.

scenarios.description: Demand increases temporally across 3 bands to demonstrate queue growth and risk emergence.
scenarios.calibration_notes: Produces ~240 vehicles, speed drops to 3.0 km/h, max Q 165m. Queue visibly accumulates later in the simulation.

scenarios.description: Sustained high-volume traffic exceeding intersection clearance capacity.
scenarios.calibration_notes: Produces ~380+ inserted vehicles with significant buffering. Speed ~3.3 km/h with extensive continuous queuing (max Q 245m).

scenarios.description: Physical breakdown in lane 0 feeding Sancheti to Shivaji Road (J2) causing localized lane restriction.
scenarios.calibration_notes: Similar base demand to NORMAL but bottleneck forces lane changing and reduces physical throughput. Max Q 155m.
